reviewMethod: Individually viewed all nine full native Device Hub raw windows, all nine real-device crops, all nine final PNG posters and the mixed-orientation contact sheet; compared original UI and hardware against output. Every saved crop additionally passed decoded per-pixel RGB equality and exact hash/geometry audit.

sourceIntegrity.pixelAudit: Decoded source-to-crop RGB equality for every pixel, including transparent pixels; exact source/crop/output hashes passed.

entries.headline: Play inside a reply
entries.observation: Genuine folded English 2048 reply after 12 real swipes reported by the capture operator; visible Score 52, Best 52, a 16 tile, numbered board, restart control and Swipe to move. Complete left folded rear panel, camera hole, top and right physical buttons. Small diagonal arrows are the native expand control, not a mouse pointer.

entries.headline: Turn data into charts
entries.observation: Genuine unfolded landscape workspace with English six-week LCP chart: four orange and two green bars, 1.60 s / 42.1% improvement and 2 of 6 weeks good. Native sidebar and composer retained. Grey send arrow and blue-grey context-window control; top text continues beyond the native scroll viewport.

entries.headline: Browse the web in Palmi
entries.observation: Genuine unfolded landscape in-app English web.dev LCP page, good-score paragraph, 2.5 second threshold diagram, English menu and address bar. Complete rim, hinge and top/right physical buttons.

entries.headline: Open your project files
entries.observation: Genuine unfolded landscape report.md preview with English Close, LCP trend report, 3.80 s to 2.20 s result, key numbers and weekly table. Table continues below the native scroll viewport; complete screen and hardware retained.

entries.headline: Set the thinking level
entries.observation: Genuine folded Thinking Effort popover with Configure, Medium, slider and model field over the completed chart/file reply. Native model name and narrow Medium control wrapping preserved; full rear folded panel, camera hole and physical buttons retained.

entries.headline: Follow every step
entries.observation: Genuine unfolded landscape English Reasoning process, Elapsed 1m 8s, with completed Thinking, List Directory, Get Time and Write File steps. Lower steps continue at the native viewport edge; complete hardware retained.

entries.headline: Run Python on device
entries.observation: Genuine unfolded landscape native file preview of python-scripts_analyze.log. Original small monospace font preserved; English readings, 3.80 s to 2.20 s, 42.1%, mean 2.93 s and generated metrics.csv, report.md, chart.html are readable in the final PNG. No diagnostic-panel Chinese.

entries.headline: Import your own skills
entries.observation: Genuine unfolded landscape English Skills panel with Done, Import File, support for .zip or SKILL.md, System skills, and two required built-in skills. Complete panel and hardware; original skill identifiers retained.

entries.headline: Take a break with Palmi
entries.observation: Genuine folded Palmi conversation with visible English break/homepage/water/notebook messages and Message Palmi composer. No Chinese visible inside the poster; Chinese Device Hub sidebar labels remain only outside the hardware in the raw window. Original native header/composer glass blur preserved. No keyboard or active generation indicator.
